# Nova Intelligence

Nova Intelligence is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Nova Intelligence is an agency platform that unifies enterprise system discovery, design, build, and operations in one platform. Nova Intelligence employs 34 people (+277.8% YoY, +25 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, Germany, Poland, United Kingdom, and Mexico).

## About

Nova is the agentic AI platform for enterprise systems, unifying operational and development teams on one system of intelligence. Acting as an autonomous, always-improving colleague across your SAP lifecycle, Nova discovers how your landscape is architected, designs fit-to-standard configurations, builds working software from specs, and proactively preempts issues and optimizes processes. Teams using Nova see 5x productivity, 50% lower project costs, and 8x faster issue resolution, and tasks run on Nova compound into a knowledge core that grows with your business.

  > KION Group is taking 86% of the time out of core SAP work with Nova Intelligence.
  >
  > If you’ve bought anything online, there’s a good chance your order passed through a warehouse equipped or automated by a KION Group system. Behind that global operation is an SAP landscape supporting 42,000 employees across more than 100 countries.
  >
  > KION built its S/4HANA system greenfield and around Clean Core principles. But, as with most transformations, some functionality still has to make the journey from ECC.
  >
  > Nova Intelligence now helps KION tackle both sides of that equation: modernizing what came before, while holding what gets built next to a higher standard.
  >
  > 𝗜𝗻 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁: SAP artifact and table research that took 3+ hours now takes just over 10 minutes. Root-cause analysis and resolution for production incidents has fallen from 2–3 hours to 15 minutes.
  >
  > 𝗜𝗻 𝗱𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: KION has reduced average time spent on code refactoring and development by 80%. In one example, Nova helped modernize two SD reports, cutting application runtimes by 65% and 81% and HANA CPU consumption by 85%.
  >
  > 𝗜𝗻 𝗖𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲: Nova checks new requirements against standard SAP functionality before custom development is approved, applies KION’s own development and documentation standards, and is now powering a quality gate that reviews changes before they move downstream.
  >
  > And every time Nova investigates, builds, or changes something, it leaves behind the documentation and context KION’s SAP experts can reuse.
  >
  > As KION's SAP Solution Architect Saber LAMINE puts it: “𝗜𝘁 𝗱𝗼𝗲𝘀𝗻'𝘁 𝗳𝗲𝗲𝗹 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀, 𝗶𝘁 𝗳𝗲𝗲𝗹𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝘄𝗲'𝘃𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 𝗼𝗳 𝗰𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗴𝘂𝗲𝘀.”

# Nova Inteligência | Assessoria de Marketing e Vendas

Nova Inteligência | Assessoria de Marketing e Vendas is a Advertising Services company. Nova Inteligência is a digital marketing agency focused on results. They specialize in traffic generation, lead generation, and product launch. Nova Inteligência | Assessoria de Marketing e Vendas employs 22 people (-8.3% YoY, -2 people), founded in 2010. Headquartered in Maringá, Paraná, Brazil.

## About

Nova Inteligência é uma assessoria de marketing, vendas e inteligência artificial para pequenas e médias empresas que querem crescer com mais clareza, processo e resultado. Partimos dos seus objetivos, gargalos e capacidade de entrega para transformar estratégia em execução.
